phase1_summary.P1.1: Supply chain: added dependency file parsing (requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/package.json), fixed response schemas. 52 packages registered, SBOM generation, typosquatting detection all verified.
phase1_summary.P1.2: CI/CD: quality gate evaluation already fully implemented. Fixed response schemas. Gate correctly evaluates severity counts against configurable thresholds.
phase1_summary.P1.3: Privacy: added regex PII pattern detection (SSN, CC, email, phone, IP, DOB, passport, financial), implemented DB-backed PII exposure analysis, added POST /pii-scan endpoint. PIA runs end-to-end with framework compliance checks.

phase2_summary.P2.2: Finding verification columns: added verification_status, verification_model, verification_reasoning, verified_at to findings table.
phase2_summary.P2.3: Migration (a1b2c3d4e5f6), repositories (GuardrailSetRepository, ExplanationRepository), and DI wiring (GuardrailSetRepo, ExplanationRepo type aliases).

GET endpoints: guardrails by-id and by-scan, explanations by-finding and by-scan with type filter. Fixed explain_scan include_similar bug and verified_at timezone-naive datetime fix.

phase3_summary.P3.1: Event wiring: Added SCAN_PROGRESS to progress bridge, EXPLANATION_GENERATED to all 4 explainability POST endpoints, REMEDIATION_PLAN_GENERATED to remediation endpoint, GUARDRAIL_GENERATED (new event type) to guardrails endpoint, REPORT_GENERATED to report generation, PROBE_STARTED/COMPLETED/FAILED to interrogation, AUTH_SUCCESS/AUTH_FAILURE to auth middleware. Total active event types: 24+ (up from 14).
phase3_summary.P3.2: Metrics instrumentation: mass_scans_total (counter with profile label), mass_scans_active (gauge), mass_findings_total (counter), mass_findings_by_severity (counter with severity label), mass_probe_executions_total (counter), mass_worker_jobs_processed/failed (counters). Existing mass_api_requests_total and mass_api_latency_seconds in logging middleware verified working. /metrics endpoint returns Prometheus text format.
